text: kho pañcasikha manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti na tadupādānaṃ . anupādāno pañcasikha bhikkhu parinibbāyati . ayaṃ kho pañcasikha hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti . chaṭṭhaṃ . [183] ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sārīputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme . atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami
